summary: Project Akshaya3 is an innovative project that aims to use space science, technology, and data to understand and solve real-world problems. Our project focuses on exploring useful information from space and Earth observations to create meaningful solutions. It aims to make information easier to understand and help people become more aware of important environmental and scientific challenges. Through this project, we want to encourage innovation, teamwork, creativity, and problem-solving. Our goal is to develop a useful solution that can create a positive impact on society and contribute to a better future. This project gives us an opportunity to learn new technologies and apply our knowledge to real-world challenges.
details: Our project, Project Akshaya3, focuses on using space science and Earth observation data to understand real-world challenges and explore innovative solutions. The project aims to collect, study, and present useful information about Earth and environmental conditions in a simple and understandable way. Our approach involves researching space-related information, analyzing available data, identifying important problems, and exploring possible solutions. The project can help create awareness, support learning, and encourage people to understand environmental and scientific challenges. We aim to use technology, data analysis, creativity, and problem-solving skills to develop a useful solution. Our development approach includes research, teamwork, planning, and digital tools. The creative aspect of our project is connecting space science with real-world problems. Our intended impact is to promote scientific awareness, encourage innovation, and contribute to a better and more sustainable future.
